		TREATAS({2010}, 'dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[NU_ANO_INGRESSO])

	VAR __DS0Core =

DEFINE

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'LocalDateTable_3d5bad52-3e9c-4739-a89b-40b3c5c82f36'[Ano],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"AverageVL_TDAN", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[VL_TDAN])),
			"AverageVL_TCAN", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[VL_TCAN])),
			"MinDate", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('LocalDateTable_3d5bad52-3e9c-4739-a89b-40b3c5c82f36'[Date])))
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(
			3500,
			__DS0Core,
			[MinDate],
			[AverageVL_TDAN],
			[AverageVL_TCAN],
			350,
			,
			ALPHABETICAL,
			ASC,
			105000,
			60
		)

	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'LocalDateTable_3d5bad52-3e9c-4739-a89b-40b3c5c82f36'[Ano]

		"PRE_PUB_DESISTENCIA", 'dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[PRE_PUB_DESISTENCIA],
		"PRE_DESISTENCIA", 'dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[PRE_DESISTENCIA],
		"EAD_DESISTENCIA", 'dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[EAD_DESISTENCIA],
		"EAD_PUB_DESISTENCIA", 'dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[EAD_PUB_DESISTENCIA]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dw DIM_TIPO_GRAU_ACADEMICO'[Grau Acadêmico])),
			NOT('dw DIM_TIPO_GRAU_ACADEMICO'[Grau Acadêmico] IN {BLANK(),
				"Não informado"})
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dw DIM_TIPO_GRAU_ACADEMICO'[Grau Acadêmico],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"PCT_DESISTENCIA", 'dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[PCT_DESISTENCIA]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [PCT_DESISTENCIA], 0, 'dw DIM_TIPO_GRAU_ACADEMICO'[Grau Acadêmico], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[PCT_DESISTENCIA] DESC, 'dw DIM_TIPO_GRAU_ACADEMICO'[Grau Acadêmico]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dw DIM_CURSO'[Curso],
			"DM0_Sort", DIVIDE('dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[EAD_DESISTENCIA], CALCULATE('dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[EAD_DESISTENCIA], ALLSELECTED('dw DIM_CURSO'[Curso]))),
			"M1", DIVIDE('dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[PRE_DESISTENCIA], CALCULATE('dw FTO_DADOS_FLUXO'[PRE_DESISTENCIA], ALLSELECTED('dw DIM_CURSO'[Curso])))
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(501, __DS0Core, [DM0_Sort], 0, 'dw DIM_CURSO'[Curso], 1)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"MinDM0_Sort", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [DM0_Sort]),
		"MaxDM0_Sort", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [DM0_Sort]),
		"MinM1", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [M1]),
		"MaxM1", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [M1])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[DM0_Sort] DESC, 'dw DIM_CURSO'[Curso]
